name: cavemio-diff-review
title: Diff review
description: Accept or reject what the AI changed, word by word for prose or line by line for code.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Removed and added words are real <del> and <ins>, and code lines carry "(added)" or "(removed)" for screen readers.
- Colour is never the only signal: removed text is struck through, and code lines have + and − gutters.
- Each button names its change ("Accept Paragraph 2"), and the count is announced as decisions are made. Focus moves to Undo after a decision and back to the button after Undo, so keyboard users never lose their place.
- Words that have folded away are hidden from screen readers. Installs Number roll and Text morph; with reduced motion, decisions change the text in place.
- The diff is a longest-common-subsequence over words or lines; very large inputs fall back to a full replace.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: changes
props.description: – · Each change; the label says where it is, like a paragraph or file name.

props.name: mode
props.description: "words" · Compare word by word (prose) or line by line (code).

props.name: decisions / defaultDecisions
props.description: – · Controlled or initial decisions; missing ids are pending.

props.name: onDecisionsChange
props.description: – · Every decision after a change, in one call even for Accept all.

props.name: onDecisionChange
props.description: – · Each individual decision, including Undo back to pending.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: – · Called when the last pending change gets a decision.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: false · Shows decisions without Undo or buttons, e.g. once they’ve been sent.

useCases.title: AI writing tools
useCases.description: Let people accept or reject the AI’s edits to each paragraph.

useCases.title: Coding assistants
useCases.description: Review the changes to a file line by line before applying them.

useCases.title: Content and CMS editors
useCases.description: Review a rewrite of a page in the style of tracked changes.

useCases.title: Drafting replies
useCases.description: Show what the AI changed in a customer reply before it is sent.

features.title: It works out the difference
features.description: Give each change as before and after text. Removed words are struck in red and added words marked in green.

features.title: Words for prose, lines for code
features.description: Choose word-by-word or line-by-line comparison to suit what is being edited.

features.title: Accept or reject, one or all
features.description: Decide one change at a time or all at once, and undo any decision.

features.title: It resolves in place
features.description: Accepting shrinks the removed words out of the sentence and the added ones lose their tint. Nothing is swapped for a new block.

features.title: It tells you when you’re done
features.description: The count rolls from “3 to review” to “2 of 3 accepted”, and onComplete fires with every decision.

features.title: Not colour alone
features.description: Removed text is struck through, code lines have + and − gutters, and each button names its change.

states.title: pending
states.description: The change inline with Reject and Accept; the header counts what’s left to review, rolling as you go.

states.title: accepted
states.description: Removed words shrink out of the line (460ms) and added ones lose their tint; code lines that go fold shut. "Accept" morphs to "Accepted" as a green check draws itself, Reject folds away and Undo opens in.

states.title: rejected
states.description: The reverse: added words shrink away and the struck ones return as plain, muted text; "Reject" morphs to "Rejected".

states.title: done
states.description: "3 to review" morphs to "2 of 3 accepted"; onComplete fires with every decision.
